verse.verse_1: Inã rantsuwa da mãsu yin sahu-sahu (a cikin salla kõ yãƙi).
verse.verse_2: Sa'an nan mãsu yin tsãwa dõmin gargaɗi.
verse.verse_3: Sa'an nan da mãsu karãtun abin tunãtarwa.
verse.verse_5: Ubangijin sammai da ƙasã da abin da ke tsakãninsu, kuma Ubangijin wurãren fitar rãnã.
verse.verse_6: Lalle Mũ, Mun ƙãwatãr da sama ta kusa da wata ƙawa, watau taurãri.
verse.verse_7: Kuma sunã tsari daga dukan Shaiɗan mai tsaurin kai.
verse.verse_8: Bã zã su iya saurãre zuwa ga jama'a mafi ɗaukaka (Malã'iku) ba, kuma anã jĩfar su daga kõwane gẽfe.
verse.verse_9: Dõmin tunkuɗẽwa kuma sunã da wata azãba tabbatacciya.
verse.verse_10: Fãce wanda ya fizgi wata kalma, sai yũla mai haske ta bĩ shi.
verse.verse_11: Ka tambaye su: "Shin sũ ne mafi wuya ga halittawa, kõ, kuwa waɗanda Muka halitta?" Lalle Mũ, Mun halitta su daga lãkã mai ɗauri.
verse.verse_12: Ã'a, kã yi mãmãki, alhãli kuwa sunã ta yin izgili.
verse.verse_13: Kuma idan aka tunãtar da su, bã su tunãwa.
verse.verse_14: Idan suka ga wata ãyã, sai su dinga yin izgili.
verse.verse_15: Kuma su ce, "Wannnan bã kõme ba, fãce sihiri, ne bayyananne."
verse.verse_16: "Shin, idan mun mutu, kuma muka kasance turɓaya da kasũsuwa, ashe, lalle mũ tabbas waɗandaake tãyarwa ne?
verse.verse_18: Ka ce: "Na'am alhãli kuwa kunã ƙasƙantattu."
verse.verse_19: Tsãwa guda kawai ce, sai gã su, sunã dũbi.
verse.verse_20: Kuma su ce: "Yã bonenmu! Wannan ita ce rãnar sakamako."
verse.verse_21: Wannan ita ce rãnar rarrabẽwa wadda kuka kasance kuna ƙaryatãwa.
verse.verse_22: Ku tãra waɗanda suka yi zãlunci, da abõkan haɗinsu, da abin da suka kasance sunã bautãwa.
verse.verse_23: Wanin Allah, sabõda haka ku shiryar da su zuwa ga hanyar Jahĩm.
verse.verse_24: Kuma ku tsayar da su, lalle su, waɗanda ake yi wa tambaya ne.
verse.verse_25: Me ya sãme ku, bã ku taimakon jũna?
verse.verse_26: Ã'a, sũ a yau, mãsu sallamãwa ne.
verse.verse_27: Kuma sãshensu ya fuskanta ga sãshe, sunã tambayar jũna.
verse.verse_28: Suka ce: "Lalle kũ, kun kasance kunã jẽ mana daga wajen dãma (inda muka amince)."
verse.verse_29: Suka ce: "Ã'a, ba ku kasance mũminai ba.
verse.verse_30: "Kuma wani dalĩli bai kasance ba gare mu a kanku. Ã'a, kun kasance mutãne ne mãsu kẽtare iyãka."
verse.verse_31: "Sabõda haka maganar Ubangijinmu ta wajaba a kanmu. Lalle mũ, mãsu ɗanɗanãwa ne."
verse.verse_32: "Sabõda haka muka ɓatar da ku. Lalle mũ, mun kasance ɓatattu."
verse.verse_33: To lalle sũ a rãnar nan, mãsu tãrayya ne a cikin azãbar.
verse.verse_34: Lalle Mũ, kamar haka Muke aikatãwa game, da mãsu laifi.
verse.verse_35: Lalle sũ, sun kasance idan an ce musu: "Bãbu abin bautãwa, fãce Allah," sai su dõra girman kai.
verse.verse_36: Kuma sunã cẽwa, "Shin, mũ lalle mãsu barin gumãkanmu ne, sabõda maganar wani mawãƙi mahaukaci?
verse.verse_37: Ã'a, yã zo da gaskiya kuma ya gaskata Manzanni.
verse.verse_38: Lalle kũ, haƙĩƙa mãsu ɗanɗana azãba mai raɗaɗi ne.
verse.verse_39: Kuma bã zã a sãka muku ba fãce da abin da kuka kasance kunã aikatãwa.
verse.verse_40: Fãce bãyin Allah waɗanda aka tsarkake.
verse.verse_42: 'Ya'yan itãcen marmari, kuma sunã waɗanda ake girmamãwa.
verse.verse_44: A kan karagu, sunã mãsu fuskantar jũna.
verse.verse_45: Anã kẽwayãwa a kansu da hinjãlan giya, ta daga waɗansu marẽmari.
verse.verse_47: A cikinta bãbu jirĩ kuma ba su zama mãsu mãye daga gare ta ba,
verse.verse_48: Kuma a wurinsu, akwai mãtan aure mãsu taƙaita kallonsu, mãsu manyan idãnu.
verse.verse_49: Kamar dai su ƙwai ne ɓõyayye.
verse.verse_50: Sai sãshensu ya fuskanta a kan sãshe, sunã tambayar jũna.
verse.verse_51: Wani mai magana daga cikinsu ya ce: "Lalle ni wani abõki ya kasance a gare ni (a dũniya)."
verse.verse_52: Yanã cewa, "Shin, kai lalle, kanã daga mãsu gaskatãwa ne?"
verse.verse_53: "Ashe, idan muka mutu, kuma muka, kasance turɓaya da kasũsuwa, ashe, lalle, mũ tabbas waɗanda ake sãka wa ne?"
verse.verse_54: (Mai maganar) ya ce: "Shin, kõ ku, mãsu tsinkãya ne (mu gan shi)?"
verse.verse_55: Sai ya tsinkãya, sai ya gan shi a cikin tsakar Jahim.
verse.verse_56: Ya ce (masa), "Wallahi, lalle, kã yi kusa, haƙĩƙã, ka halakãni."
verse.verse_57: "Kuma bã dõmin ni'imar Ubangijĩna ba, lalle, dã na kasance daga waɗanda ake halartarwa (tãre da kai a cikin wutã)."
verse.verse_58: "Shin fa, ba mu zama mãsu mutuwa ba."
verse.verse_59: "Sai mutuwarmu ta farko, kuma ba mu zama waɗanda ake azabtarwa ba?"
verse.verse_60: Lalle, wannan shĩ ne babban rabo mai girma.
verse.verse_61: Sabõda irin wannan, sai mãsu aiki su yi ta aikatãwa.
verse.verse_62: Shin wancan shĩ ne mafi zama alhẽri ga liyafa kõ itãciyar zaƙƙũm?
verse.verse_63: Lalle, Mũ, Mun sanya ta fitina ga. azzãlumai.
verse.verse_64: Lalle ita wata itãciya ce wadda take fita daga asalin Jahĩm.
verse.verse_65: Gundarta, kamar dai shi kãnun Shaiɗan ne.
verse.verse_66: To, lalle sũ haƙĩƙa mãsu ci ne daga gare ta. Sa'an nan mãsu cika cikuna ne daga gare ta.
verse.verse_67: Sa'an nan lalle sunã da wani garwaye a kanta, daga ruwan zãfi.
verse.verse_68: Sa'an nan lalle makomarsu, haƙĩƙa, zuwa ga Jãhĩm take.
verse.verse_69: Lalle sũ, sun iske ubanninsu batattu.
verse.verse_70: Sabõda haka sũ, a kan gurãbunsu, suke gaggãwa.
verse.verse_71: Kuma tabbas haƙĩƙa mafi yawan mutãnen farko sun ɓace a gabãninsu.
verse.verse_72: Kuma tabbas haƙĩƙa, Mun aika mãsu gargaɗi a cikinsu.
verse.verse_73: Sai ka dũba yadda ãƙibar waɗanda aka yi wa gargaɗi ta kasance.
verse.verse_74: Fãce bãyin Allah waɗanda aka tsarkake.
verse.verse_75: Kuma lalle, haƙĩƙa' Nũhu ya kira Mu. To, madalla da mãsu karɓãwa, Mu.
verse.verse_76: Kuma Mun tsĩrar da shi da mutãnensa daga bakin ciki babba.
verse.verse_77: Muka sanya zurriyarsa sunã mãsu wanzuwa.
verse.verse_78: Kuma Muka bar masa (yabo) a cikin jama'ar ƙarshe.
verse.verse_79: Aminci ya tabbata ga Nũhu, a cikin halittu.
verse.verse_80: Lalle Mũ kamar haka Muke sãka wa mãsu kyautatãwa.
verse.verse_81: Lalle shi, yanã daga bãyinMu mũminai.
verse.verse_82: Sã'an nan Muka nutsar da waɗansunsu.
verse.verse_83: Kuma lalle daga ƙungiyarsa, haƙĩƙa, Ibrahĩm yake.
verse.verse_84: A lõkacin da ya je wa dangijinsa da zũciya kuɓutacciya.
verse.verse_85: A lõkacin da ya ce wa ubansa da mutãnensa, "Mẽne ne kuke bautãwa?"
verse.verse_86: "Shin, ƙiren ƙarya (wãtau) gumãka, wanin Allah, kuke bautãwa?"
verse.verse_87: "To, mẽne ne zatonku game da Ubangijin halittu?"
verse.verse_88: Sai ya yi dũbi, dũba ta sõsai, a cikin taurãri.
verse.verse_89: Sã'an nan ya ce: "Nĩ mai rashin lãfiya ne."
verse.verse_90: Sai suka jũya ga barinsa, sunã mãsu jũyãwa da bãya.
verse.verse_91: Sai ya karkata zuwa ga gumãkansu, sa'an nan ya ce: "Ashe bã zã ku ci ba?
verse.verse_92: "Me ya sãme ku, bã ku magana?"
verse.verse_93: Sai ya zuba dũka a kansu da hannun dãma.
verse.verse_94: Sai suka fuskanto zuwa gare shi, sunã gaggãwa.
verse.verse_95: Ya ce, "Kunã bauta wa abin da kuke sassaƙawa,
verse.verse_96: "Alhãli, Allah ne Ya halitta ku game da abin da kuke aikatãwa?"
verse.verse_97: Suka ce: "Ku gina wani gini sabõda shi, sa'an nan ku jẽfa shi a cikin Jahĩm."
verse.verse_98: Sabõda haka suka yi nufin makĩda game da shi. Sai Muka sanya su, sũ ne mafi ƙasƙanci.
verse.verse_99: Kuma (Ibrahĩm] ya ce: "Lalle, nĩ mai tafiya ne zuwa ga Ubangijĩna, zai shiryar da ni."
verse.verse_100: "Ya Ubangijĩna! Ka bã ni (abõkin zama) daga sãlihan mutãne."
verse.verse_101: Sai Muka yi masa bushãra da wani yãro mai haƙuri.
verse.verse_102: To, a lõkacin da ya isa aiki tãre da shi, ya ce: "Ya ƙaramin ɗãna! Lalle ne inã gani, a ciki barci, lalle inã yanka ka. To, ka dũba mẽ ka gani?" (Yãron) ya ce: "Ya, Bãbãna! Ka aikata abin da aka umurce ka, zã ka sãme ni, in Allah Ya so, daga mãsu haƙuri."
verse.verse_103: To, a lõkacin da suka yi sallama, (Ibrahĩm) ya kãyar da shi ga gẽfen gõshinsa.
verse.verse_104: Kuma Muka kira shi cẽwa "Ya Ibrahĩm!"
verse.verse_105: "Haƙĩƙa kã gaskata mafarkin." Lalle kamar haka Muke sãka wa mãsu kyautatãwa.
verse.verse_106: Lalle wannan ita ce jarrabãwa bayyananna.
verse.verse_107: Kuma Muka yi fansar yãron da wani abin yanka, mai girma.
verse.verse_108: Kuma Muka bar (yabo) a kansa a cikin mutãnen ƙarshe.
verse.verse_110: Kamar haka Muke sãka wa mãsu kyautatãwa.
verse.verse_111: Lalle shĩ, yanã daga bãyinMu mũminai.
verse.verse_112: Kuma Muka yi masa bushãra Da Is'hãƙa ya zama Annabi daga sãlihan mutãne.
verse.verse_113: Kuma Muka yi albarka a gare shi, kuma ga Is'hãka. Kuma daga cikin zurriyarsu akwai mai kyautatãwa da kuma maizãlunci dõmin kansa, mai bayyanãwa (ga zãluncin).
verse.verse_114: Kuma lalle, Mun yi ni'ima ga Mũsã da Hãrũna.
verse.verse_115: Kuma Muka tsĩrar da su da mutãnensu daga bakin ciki mai girma.
verse.verse_116: Kuma Muka taimake su, sabõda haka suka kasance mãsu rinjãya.
verse.verse_117: Kuma Muka ba su Littãfi mai iyãkar bayãni.
verse.verse_118: Kuma Muka shiryar da su ga hanya mĩƙaƙƙiya.
verse.verse_119: Kuma Muka bar (yabo) a gare su a cikin mutãnen karshe.
verse.verse_120: Aminci ya tabbata ga Mũsã da Hãruna.
verse.verse_121: Lalle kamar haka Muke sãka wa mãsu kyautatãwa.
verse.verse_123: Kuma lalle Ilyãs, haƙĩƙa, yanã daga Manzanni.
verse.verse_124: A lõkacin da yake ce wa mutãnensa, "Ashe, bã zã ku yi taƙawa ba?"
verse.verse_125: "Shin, kunã bauta wa Ba'al ne, kuma kunã barin Mafi kyautatãwar mãsu halitta?"
verse.verse_127: Sai suka ƙaryata shi. Sabõda haka sũ lalle waɗanda zã a halartãwa ne (a wutã).
verse.verse_128: Sai bãyin Allah waɗanda aka tsarkake.
verse.verse_129: Kuma Muka bar (yabo) a gare shi, a cikin mutãnen ƙarshe.
verse.verse_131: Lalle Mũ kamar haka Muke sãka wa mãsu kyautatãwa.
verse.verse_132: Lalle shĩ, yanã daga bãyinMu mũminai.
verse.verse_133: Kuma lalle Lũdu, haƙĩƙa, yanã daga Manzanni.
verse.verse_134: A lõkacin da Muka tsĩrar da shi, da mutãnensa gabã ɗaya.
verse.verse_135: Sai wata tsõhuwa tanã a cikin mãsu wanzuwa (a cikin azãba).
verse.verse_136: Sã'an nan Muka darkãke waɗansu mutãnen.
verse.verse_137: Kuma lalle kũ, haƙĩƙa, kunã shũɗewa a kansu, kunã mãsu asubanci.
verse.verse_138: Kuma da dare. Shin fa, bã zã ku hankalta ba?
verse.verse_139: Kuma lalle Yũnusa, haƙĩƙa, yanã daga Manzanni.
verse.verse_140: A lõkacin da ya gudu zuwa ga jirgin ruwa wanda aka yi wa lõdi.
verse.verse_141: Sã'an nan ya yi ƙuri'a, sai ya kasance a cikin waɗanda aka rinjaya.
verse.verse_142: Sai kĩfi ya yi lõma da shi, alhãli kuwa yanã wanda ake zargi.
verse.verse_143: To, ba dõmin lalle shi ya kasance daga mãsu tasbĩhi ba,
verse.verse_144: Lalle dã ya zauna a cikin cikinsa har ya zuwa rãnar da zã a tãyar da su.
verse.verse_145: Sai Muka jẽfa shi ga wani fĩli alhãli kuwa yanã mai raunin rashin lãfiya.
verse.verse_146: Kuma Muka tsirar da wata itãciya ta kankana a kusa da shi.
verse.verse_147: Kuma Muka aika shi zuwa ga waɗansu mutãne dubuɗari, kõ sunã ƙaruwa (a kan haka).
verse.verse_148: Sai suka yi ĩmãni sabõda haka Muka jiyar da su dãdi har wani lõkaci.
verse.verse_149: Sabõda haka, ka tambaye su, "Shin, Ubangijinka ne da 'ya'ya mãtã, kuma su da ɗiya maza?"
verse.verse_150: Kõ kuma Mun halitta malã'iku mãtã ne, alhãli kuwa sũ sunãhalarce?
verse.verse_151: To! Lalle sũ, daga ƙiren ƙaryarsu sunã cẽwa.
verse.verse_152: "Allah Yã haihu," alhãli kuwa lalle sũ, haƙĩƙa maƙaryata ne.
verse.verse_153: Shin, Yã zãɓi 'yã'ya mãtã ne a kan ɗiya maza?
verse.verse_154: Mẽ ya same ku? Yãya kuke hukuntãwa (wannanhukunci)?
verse.verse_156: Ko kuma kunã da wani dalĩli bayyananne ne?
verse.verse_157: To, ku zo da littãfinku idan kun kasance mãsu gaskiya.
verse.verse_158: Kuma suka sanya nasaba a tsakãninSa da tsakãnin aljannu. Alhãli kuwa Lalle aljannu sun sani, "Lalle sũ, haƙĩƙa waɗanda ake halartarwa ne (a cikin wutã.)"
verse.verse_159: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah daga abin da suke siffantãwa.
verse.verse_160: Sai bãyin Allah waɗanda aka tsarkake.
verse.verse_161: To, lalle, ku da abin da kuke bautãwa,
verse.verse_162: Ba ku zama mãsu buwãya ba a gare Shi.
verse.verse_163: Sai wanda yake mai shiga babbar wutã Jahĩm.
verse.verse_164: "Kuma bãbu kõwa daga cikinmu, fãce yanã da matsayi sananne."
verse.verse_165: "Kuma lalle mu, haƙĩƙa, mũ ne mãsu yin sahu-sahu (dõmin ibãda)."
verse.verse_166: "Kuma lalle mũ haƙĩƙa, mũ ne mãsu yin tasbĩhi."
verse.verse_167: Kuma lalle sũ, sun kasance sunã cẽwa,
verse.verse_168: "Dã lalle munã da wani littãfi irin na mutãnen farko."
verse.verse_169: "Lalle dã mun kasance bãyin Allah waɗanda aka tsarkake."
verse.verse_170: Sai suka kãfirta da shi. Sabõda haka zã su sani.
verse.verse_171: Kuma lalle, haƙĩƙa kalmarMu ta gabãta ga bãyinMu, Manzanni.
verse.verse_172: Lalle sũ, haƙĩƙa, sũ ne waɗanda ake taimako.
verse.verse_173: Kuma lalle rundunarMu, haƙĩƙa, sũ ne marinjaya.
verse.verse_174: Sabõda haka juya daga barinsu, har a wani lõkaci.
verse.verse_175: Ka nũna musu (gaskiya), da haka zã su dinga gani.
verse.verse_176: Shin fa, da azabarMu suke nẽman gaggãwa?
verse.verse_177: To, idan ta sauka ga farfãjiyarsu, to, sãfiyar wadanda ake yi wa gargaɗi ta mũnana.
verse.verse_178: Kuma ka jũya daga barinsu har a wani lõkaci.
verse.verse_179: Ka nũna (musu gaskiya), da haka zã su dinga nũnãwa.
verse.verse_180: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Ubangijinka, Ubangijin rinjãye, daga barin abin da suke siffantãwa.
verse.verse_181: Kuma aminci ya tabbata ga Manzanni.
verse.verse_182: Kuma gõdiya ta tabbata ga Allah Ubangijin halittu.
